text: Managing a team requires several important skills. First, good communication is essential. You need to share clear goals and listen to your team members. Second, delegation helps you share tasks fairly and use everyone's strengths. Third, giving regular feedback helps people improve and feel valued. Motivation is also key; encourage your team and recognise their hard work. Finally, when conflicts happen, solve them calmly and fairly. By using these skills, you can build a strong team where everyone works well together.
